scope: Public irrigation source register, documentary supply relationships and operator data-request text in the existing right evidence pane. No district asset geometry, private features or control-system data published. No AGOL changes.

observed: Waterway connections opens the existing nonmodal supporting-evidence surface from Rivers and Reservoirs.
Historical and unconfirmed supply relationships show dates, qualifications and official source links.
Locate Pine Flat focuses the existing reservoir reference in 3D alongside the source evidence.
Reservoirs retains F.R.O.G. Waterways basemap when opening the source pane.
At phone width, evidence stacks below the visible map with no horizontal page overflow.
Unavailable source-register fetch can be retried on reopening; covered by a runtime DOM test.

limitations: Documentary arrows are not spatially traced hydraulic routes or proof of present flow.
Current operator-verified gate, pump, intertie and from/to relationships remain pending.
FID historical archive and FMFCD facility geometry require publisher authorization before republication; only source links and aggregate findings are published.
CalWATRS regulatory identifiers and management status do not establish current operating condition.
Source discovery is dated, not a scheduled operational feed or a claim of complete district coverage.
